scope: BF16 dense TP1 eager current-source census

retention: Copied from verified retained stdout during repair; byte count and digest match the original operation. This is not a new GPU run or a pre-run plan receipt.
unobserved: artifact geometry, current recipe admission and prepared-role support predicates
artifact-derived expected module count and phase coverage
actual fused or fallback owner selection and lane_reason
immutable observed image, CUDA/driver and device identity
configured serialization acquisition and engine eager/TP/residency settings
effective serving argv/environment and split-K configuration
limits: Not census.json or serving provenance. No cell attestation, folded-claim restoration, numerical/performance qualification, contract publication or pin authority.
